sentences.en: In the holidays, came Muff Potter's trial.

sentences.ar: والقرية كلها بتحكي عنها، وتوم ما بيقدر يهرب من الحكي.
sentences.en: And the whole village was talking about it, and Tom could not escape the talk.

sentences.ar: كل ليلة، بيروح لهَك، ويحكوا بالسر.
sentences.en: Every night, he went to Huck, and they talked in secret.
Huck said: Tom, did you tell anyone?
Tom said: no.
I cannot.
The oath.
Huck said: not a word.

sentences.ar: لأنه جو الهندي بيغرقنا زي القطط.
sentences.en: Because Injun Joe would drown us like cats.
And they swore once more.
And they went to the jail, as every day.

sentences.ar: وماف قال من الشباك: يا أولاد، إنتو أحسن ناس بالدنيا.
sentences.en: And Muff said from the window: boys, you are the best people in the world.
Tomorrow they hang me, and I deserve it.
I was drunk, and I killed.
But remember me well.
And never drink.

sentences.ar: ومد إيده من القضبان، ومسك إيديهم.
sentences.en: And he put his hand through the bars, and held their hands.
And Tom went home, and did not sleep.

sentences.ar: وبنص الليل، طلع من الشباك، وراح لمكان.
sentences.en: And at midnight, he went out the window, and went somewhere.
On the day of the trial, the courtroom was full.

sentences.ar: ماف قاعد، أصفر، ومكسور، والسلاسل بإيديه.
sentences.en: Muff sat, pale, broken, chains on his hands.

sentences.ar: وجو الهندي قاعد بين الشهود، ووجهه زي الحجر.
sentences.en: And Injun Joe sat among the witnesses, his face like stone.
The witnesses told: the knife was Muff's.
And Muff was in the graveyard.
And Muff washed off blood in the river in the morning.

sentences.ar: ومحامي ماف ما سأل ولا سؤال، والناس استغربوا.
sentences.en: And Muff's lawyer asked not one question, and the people were puzzled.

sentences.ar: وبعدين وقف المحامي، وقال: بنادي توم سوير.
sentences.en: And then the lawyer stood, and said: I call Tom Sawyer.

sentences.ar: كل الوجوه لفت، وجو الهندي لف كمان.
sentences.en: Every face turned, and Injun Joe turned too.
Tom walked to the stand, shaking.

sentences.ar: قال المحامي: توم، وين كنت ليلة القتل، بنص الليل؟
sentences.en: The lawyer said: Tom, where were you on the night of the murder, at midnight?

sentences.ar: توم تطلع بجو الهندي، وضاع صوته.
sentences.en: Tom looked at Injun Joe, and his voice vanished.
And then he looked at Muff, and said: in the graveyard.
And he told.

sentences.ar: حكى كل إشي، من القطة الميتة للسكينة.
sentences.en: He told everything, from the dead cat to the knife.

sentences.ar: وكل ما يحكي، صوته يقوى، والمحكمة تسكت أكتر.
sentences.en: And the more he told, the stronger his voice grew, and the quieter the court became.

sentences.ar: ولما وصل للطعنة، وقال: وجو الهندي أخد السكينة و...
sentences.en: And when he reached the stabbing, and said: and Injun Joe took the knife and...
There was the sound of glass.

sentences.ar: جو الهندي نط من الشباك، زي النمر، واختفى.
sentences.en: Injun Joe leapt through the window, like a tiger, and vanished.
